summary: Agree Realty Corp filed an 8-K to report entry into an at-the-market equity distribution agreement for up to $1.75 billion of common stock, with multiple sales agents and forward purchasers. The filing is a routine capital-raising activity under an existing shelf program, not a special situation. No transaction price, premium, or board recommendation is involved. The ATM program allows periodic sales at market prices. No risk-arb angle; this is a standard equity financing mechanism for a REIT.
